clue.text: Whatever level of skill is achieved, it's tit for tat!

definitions.text: Whatever level of skill is achieved
definitions.meaning: the most a person can manage, the best attainable standard
retaliation in kind, giving back exactly what you receive

explanation.surface: A remark that, whatever your skill, retaliation always comes back in equal measure.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes the top standard attainable, and in 'give ... ' form it means repaying in kind, which is tit for tat.

clue.text: Like hot stuff being very eager

definitions.meaning: resembling a fiery condiment in comparison

explanation.surface: Someone who is a bit of hot stuff and terribly keen.
explanation.definitionFit: A simile comparing sharpness to the hot yellow condiment, used idiomatically to mean extremely enthusiastic.

clue.text: One getting up in Georgia's port

indicators.note: the reversed word sits inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone rising in a port belonging to Georgia.
explanation.definitionFit: Genoa is a major Italian seaport on the Ligurian coast.

clue.text: Clue Doc devised could obstruct

indicators.note: something devised is worked out anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A clue made up by a doctor might get in the way.
explanation.definitionFit: To occlude is to block or close off a passage.

clue.text: Doctor that is taken in by a book going round

indicators.note: one pair of pieces is absorbed inside the other pair

parts.note: NT is the New Testament, a book of the Bible
MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine
IE is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A medic being absorbed by a book that is being passed about.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambient means surrounding, encompassing on all sides.

clue.text: There is no fixed allowance according to the speech

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing
a ration is a fixed portion allotted to each person

explanation.surface: A claim that rationing has been abolished, according to someone's address.
explanation.definitionFit: An oration is a formal public address.

clue.text: Schoolboy, note, in a rough form

indicators.note: the letters are given only in a rough, unfinished shape, needing rearrangement

explanation.surface: A pupil's message dashed off in rough.
explanation.walkthrough: NOTE, IN and A rearranged give the pupil of Eton, the English public school.
explanation.definitionFit: An Etonian is a pupil at Eton College, a famous English boarding school for boys.

clue.text: Tree that's always environmentally friendly?

parts.note: ever means at all times
green describes things kind to the environment

explanation.surface: A question whether a tree is perpetually eco-conscious.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree that keeps its leaves all year, such as a holly or pine, is the type described.

clue.text: Drink taken before one's retirement

parts.note: retirement here is going to bed, so the drink is a sedative dose at bedtime

explanation.definitionFit: A dose of liquid sedative swallowed to bring on slumber before turning in.

clue.text: Regal creeper?

parts.note: a creeper is a crawling serpent here, and regal means royal in its name

explanation.definitionFit: A large venomous Asian snake whose name begins with a monarch's title.

clue.text: Disrobes eventually holding in fat

indicators.note: the words hold the answer within their run of letters

explanation.surface: Someone who finally undresses while keeping their tummy pulled in.
explanation.definitionFit: Obese means extremely overweight.

clue.text: Rubbing out certain to follow after time

indicators.note: the word for certain comes after the word for time

parts.note: an era is a period of time
sure means certain

explanation.surface: Erasing something that is bound to happen in due course.
explanation.definitionFit: An erasure is the act of deleting or wiping away marks.

clue.text: I sing up and be heard when it is freezing

indicators.note: the clue words are spoken, giving a phrase that sounds the same

parts.note: these words are said aloud, and what is heard is the sound this part of the answer needs

explanation.surface: A singer raising their voice so as to be audible in cold weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Ice forms on surfaces in freezing conditions, a process described by this phrasal verb.

clue.text: Modern prefix

definitions.meaning: a word-beginning added to other words

explanation.surface: A forward-thinking word-beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek-derived beginning meaning new or revived, as in neoclassical, is both modern-sounding and attached in front of words.

clue.text: Indisposition of one with mental trouble?

indicators.note: letters in trouble are disturbed and thrown into disorder

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An illness suffered by someone with psychological problems.
explanation.definitionFit: An ailment is a minor illness, a state of being unwell.

clue.text: The said lumberjack will soundly beat a mathematical aid

indicators.note: the words are spoken aloud to give a near-identical sounding term

parts.note: a lumberjack is a logger, and a beat is a rhythm; 'will soundly' just glues them together as heard

explanation.surface: A tree-feller will thrash an aid to calculation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The said' signals speech; LOGGER (lumberjack) and RHYTHM (beat) spoken together run into the mathematical term.
explanation.definitionFit: Logarithms, tabulated in books, were used to simplify multiplication before calculators.

clue.text: A crazy person might be cracked

definitions.meaning: a hard-shelled seed opened with a cracker

explanation.surface: A madman who could be bonkers.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a lunatic, and also a kernel in a shell broken open before eating.

clue.text: Ann could be enthusiastic with the material

indicators.note: suggests the name might take another form, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: keen means eager

explanation.surface: Ann might be keen on the fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Nankeen is a yellowish cotton cloth originally from Nanjing.

clue.text: Some stay readily on the Scottish coast

indicators.note: only part of the words' letters is wanted

explanation.surface: Some people readily remain at the seaside in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Ayr is a town on the Firth of Clyde in south-west Scotland, so the place is one on that shoreline.

clue.text: Meant perhaps to include silver colour

indicators.note: the rearranged letters wrap around the metal symbol
signals the word might be some other arrangement of its letters

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A colour meant to include a silvery shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Meant perhaps' looks like a remark about intention, but it is an anagram signal working on the word itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Magenta is a purplish-red shade, a dye named after an Italian battle.

clue.text: The blanks might have come from the shotgun

indicators.note: the letters have been derived from the word by rearranging

explanation.surface: Blank cartridges fired from a shotgun.
explanation.definitionFit: Zeros or ciphers are figures of nothing, empty marks.

clue.text: Idiot takes a long time to return one spear

parts.note: an ass is a fool

indicators.note: the word for a long time goes back, read right to left

parts.note: an age is a very long period
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A fool spends ages bringing back a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: An assegai is a slender iron-tipped throwing weapon used in southern Africa.

clue.text: How one might have felt when the water was taken away

definitions.text: How one might have felt when the water was taken away

parts.words: How one might have felt when the water was taken away
parts.note: a word for exhaustion also describes emptying liquid out

explanation.definitionFit: Exhausted, emptied of energy, and also of liquid when it has run off.

clue.text: Talk about useless records that are going round

indicators.note: the word for records encircles the abbreviation

parts.note: discs are gramophone records
U/S is short for unserviceable, meaning useless

explanation.surface: Debating some worthless records spinning on a turntable.
explanation.definitionFit: To discuss a topic is to talk it over.

clue.text: Run Alan over in a ring

indicators.note: being knocked over upsets the order of the letters

explanation.surface: Run Alan down in a boxing ring.
explanation.definitionFit: Annular means ring-shaped, as in an annular eclipse.

clue.text: One of a pair of slippers

definitions.text: One of a pair of slippers

parts.words: One of a pair of slippers
parts.note: slippers are things that slide over snow, not house shoes

explanation.definitionFit: A long runner strapped to a boot, worn in pairs to glide down snowy slopes.

clue.text: Composer has way with American artist first on the point

indicators.note: the artist abbreviation comes before the American one

parts.note: St is short for street, a way
RA is a Royal Academician
US is the United States
S is south, a compass point

explanation.surface: A musician makes an artistic street-side point.
explanation.definitionFit: Johann or Richard Strauss were famous composers of waltzes and operas.

clue.text: Nora, she confused the lady from Lisbon

indicators.note: mixed up, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Nora becomes muddled about the woman from Portugal.
explanation.definitionFit: Senhora is the Portuguese title for a married woman, as Lisbon is the capital of Portugal.

clue.text: Where in France one bottomless jar can be found on board

parts.note: ou is French for where
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: the word loses its final letter, its base in a down entry

explanation.surface: A French location where a bottomless jar is stowed aboard a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: The spirit-communication device is a lettered board used in seances.

clue.text: Letter, it appeared in the account by Henry

indicators.note: the word sits inside the abbreviation for account

parts.note: a/c is short for account
H is the symbol for the henry, a unit of inductance

explanation.surface: A letter found in a ledger kept by Henry.
explanation.definitionFit: The name of the eighth letter of the alphabet is spelt out as a word.

clue.text: Have fish after porridge? How tiring

indicators.note: the fish comes after the porridge

parts.note: gruel is thin oatmeal porridge
ling is a sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A meal of fish following porridge proves exhausting.
explanation.definitionFit: Gruelling means exhausting, punishingly hard.

clue.text: Homely employee?

parts.note: homely here means working in the home, not plain-looking

explanation.definitionFit: A housemaid, butler or cook is employed to work in someone's household.
